detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Utah mountains, 1860, fire, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:07. The shot begins from <Picture 4>: a medium shot of the fire in the nook at dusk, <Subject 1> in his brown felt hat and fawn coat and Lucy <Subject 1> in the slate-blue riding skirt crouched over the blaze at a normal trot, the three animals dark behind them, the boulders black. The camera is at the gap in the boulders level with a crouching man's eye, three long strides from the fire, a 35mm lens. The fire is the light, from the CENTRE. At the first frame the fire burns at the CENTRE of the frame in the BOTTOM third with John Ferrier crouched at its LEFT and Lucy at its RIGHT, their faces orange. The camera pushes in on the fire across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the flames lean and leap, from 00:00 to 00:02. At 00:02 Lucy's hands spread to the blaze. At 00:05 a horse behind them stamps once, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:06 while the flames lean and leap. By 00:07 the camera is pushing in through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
